A. Their applicability in reactions to form new carbon-carbon bonds - Diazonium salts are indeed widely used in organic synthesis to create new carbon-carbon bonds through reactions like the Sandmeyer reaction and coupling reactions.

B. Their stability - Diazonium salts are actually known for being relatively unstable, especially at higher temperatures. Many can be explosive when dry.

C. Their strong oxidizing power - While diazonium salts can participate in some redox reactions, they are not primarily valued for strong oxidizing properties.
